what: Hover a vertical card and, based on the cursor’s ratio within the card (element), it tilts at 900px perspective: up/down (y−.5)×−13° and left/right (x−.5)×20°, and it lifts 21% (16% for the top card). It takes .12s ease-out while following, and on release it settles back with a slight bounce over .4s cubic-bezier(.34,1.45,.64,1). Meanwhile a rainbow foil (.34), a white glow pool (.6) and an inner-border rainbow (.85) switch on over .35s and slide with the cursor position (background 30~70%), like a trading-card holo foil

options.apex-lift: Appears when the element has data-apex, default -16
options.flat: If 1, no tilt and only a shimmer (a card dragged over like a deck)
options.look: dodge: Dark background, light text card — foil and border pushed harder with color-dodge
options.[data-fx-part=tilt]: (If present) card to tilt — otherwise the element itself. Hover is taken from the whole element (original wraps the card in a button)
options.[data-fx-part=foil] · [data-fx-part=glar: Sparkle layer inside the card — only what you add turns on

note: On touch devices and with reduced motion it does not tilt and only applies the sparkle variables. The six rainbow colors, instead of the original fixed colors (#ff7773…#d875ff), rotate the color wheel from the accent color so they turn along when the skin changes
